verdict.rationale: The evidence says ElevenLabs Agents let developers configure turn-taking, interruption and timeout settings. It never says end-of-turn detection is model-based rather than silence/VAD timeout-based. Generic turn-taking configuration is an adjacent control, not evidence of the specific model-based capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
